title: Understanding ChatGPT Work
raw_summary: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9th, and have been furiously iterating on it ever since. It is an extraordinarily confusing and very powerful product. Here's what I've figured out about it so far. ChatGPT Work is actually two products The more interesting version of ChatGPT Work is the one that runs in the cloud. This can be accessed via chatgpt.com or through the ChatGPT mobile apps. Let's call it Work Cloud. If you install the ChatGPT desktop app - the app that used to be called Codex - you gain access to a thing called ChatGPT Work that can access files and run programs directly on your computer. Let's call that one Work Local. This one feels more like regular Codex re-skinned to be less intimidating to non-software-developers. For the rest of this article I'm going to talk exclusively about Work Cloud. Work is for paid subscribers only Right now, ChatGPT Work (in both flavors) is available only to $20/month and up subscribers. Free users and $8/month Go users do not have access. Work has features that aren't available in Chat The interface for accessing Work is a tab selector, which presents it as an alternative to Chat: The obvious question is when should I use Chat, and when should I use Work? OpenAI's official answer to that question is: Use Chat when you want an answer, explanation, brainstorm, or short draft. relevance_reason: OpenAI推出ChatGPT Work（云端任务执行代理产品），仅对付费用户开放，是AI代理商业化的重要产品迭代。
cn_summary: OpenAI于7月9日推出ChatGPT Work并持续快速迭代。产品分两个版本：Work Cloud（云端，通过chatgpt.com或移动端访问）和Work Local（桌面端，可本地访问文件并运行程序，本质是原Codex的改版）。功能目前仅向月费20美元及以上的付费订阅者开放。界面以Tab形式与Chat并列，定位差异为：Chat用于问答/解释/头脑风暴，Work用于完成有明确产出的任务（如简报、PPT、分析、自动化工作流等）。值得关注：Work将ChatGPT从对话工具升级为任务执行平台，是OpenAI推动AI Agent商业化的关键一步。
so_what: 跟踪Work付费用户渗透率与任务自动化深度，判断AI Agent商业化拐点；二阶效应看Codex/Work对Copilot等竞品压力，关注微软与OpenAI合作关系边际变化。
